markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests Normal (91%)** · Confident · Read in turn
Single-class conformal set [F1] and 5/5 neighbors support Normal on this blurred surgical frozen section.

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | Normal 91%, Benign 8%, InSitu 1%, Invasive 0% | Clear Normal lead |
| Conformal set | {Normal} (alpha 10%, 90% coverage) | Single-class 90% set |
| Reliability / OOD | 98% reliability, OOD 1.0 (12/12 regions) [F6] | Passes QC despite blur |
| CONCH–MUSK agreement | True (same top class) | Independent models agree |
| Similar cases | 5/5 Normal (83%–86% similarity) [F5] | All nearest neighbors match |

## Tissue evidence
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (region 7) · ↓ invasive · Below-typical score (0.15, contribution -0.42) lowers invasive risk [F2] · Validated
- **Benign fibrous stroma or fat** (regions 7, 10, 11) · ↓ invasive · Above-typical score (1.14, contribution -0.35) supports Normal [F3] · Validated
- **Frequent mitotic figures** (region 11) · ↓ invasive · Below-typical score (-0.25, contribution -0.32); 0/20 spot check [F4] · Unreliable
- **Atypical cells confined within ducts** (region 5) · ↑ invasive · Low score (-0.03, contribution +0.27) slightly offsets Normal · Weak

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Faithful; deleting top-3 risk regions beats random (+0.011, 95% CI 0.002–0.020, n=132).
- **Concepts**: Unproven (deletion +0.001, CI -0.009–0.006); case leans on Unreliable mitoses (0/20 spot check).

## Could be wrong if
- Severity-3 blur on frozen section masks atypia; reliability moderately ranks errors (AUROC 70%).
- Region 6 (35% risk) or Benign contrast BACH_0027 (81% similarity; TILs, Unreliable necrosis) reflects missed lesion.

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 6, 10**: Highest local risk (35%, 6%) and pleomorphism; verify blur hides no atypia.
2. **Regions 7, 11**: Confirm benign stroma; rule out mitoses (Unreliable 0/20) or TIL-masked lesion.
3. **Regions 0, 3**: Inspect superior/medial (96%) and lateral (82%) edges despite clear margin call [F7].
